description: Send the crew to work a campaign now. With only the campaign id it takes the reachable contacts not yet in a play (company lines, not excluded), easiest first, up to limit (default 10, max 25), and switches a paused campaign on. Pass contact_ids to choose. Spends credits.

limit.description: How many to start when no contact_ids are given (1-25).

name: work_campaign
title: Work a campaign
